Zoe (Incident Lead): :rotating_light: opening warroom for recurring 504/timeout spike on hosted inference (us-west) — multiple customers reporting API timeouts + elevated 5xxs
Sunita (SRE): seeing surge at the gateway level, stack traces point to auth refresh requests backing up auth-proxy -> origin
Eli (Runtime): runtime metrics show KV cache miss rate jumping ~3x, batcher backlog growth, some large requests causing token refresh churn
Jess (Support): customers reporting timeouts starting ~00:20 UTC, one high-volume customer throttled and retried aggressively :frowning
Sunita (SRE): correlation - high batch sizes from a single client caused spikes in prefix cache eviction; auth-proxy started hitting 503s -> gateway returning 504s
Zoe (Incident Lead): immediate mitigations?
Sunita (SRE): throttling that customer's API key at the gateway temporarily, rolling out patch to reduce max batch size to 256 for us-west pool
Eli (Runtime): enabling KV-prefetch and raising keepalive for runtime->auth-proxy connections to prevent transient reconnect storms
DeployBot: deploy started: reduce-max-batch-size v2 -> us-west pool (canary 25%)
Mike (Product): alert CS to hold communications, ask customers to limit large single-batch calls for now
Jess (Support): on it — sent rapid note to impacted accounts, offering retry/backoff guidance
Sunita (SRE): quick log snippet from auth-proxy during spike:
```
ERROR auth-proxy timeout token-refresh id=0x9f3f req=1423ms upstream_err=EAGAIN
WARN auth-cache miss_count=1123 miss_rate=0.72
TRACE gateway connpool overflow queued=834
```
Eli (Runtime): repro steps I ran locally: run a loop of 200 concurrent requests with batch-size=4096 -> auth-proxy dropps, runtime KV gets reclaimed, p99 token refresh +3s
Zoe (Incident Lead): plan for containment -> short term actions and owners
Sunita (SRE): containment: 1) throttle offending API key (done) 2) reduce default max batch size on gateway 3) increase auth-proxy concurrency limit temporarily
Eli (Runtime): runtime patch: enable KV-prefetch + bump keepalive (in flight)
Jess (Support): customer comm sent, offered manual throttling if they want us to handle it
Mike (Product): escalate to account exec for the largest customer impacted
DeployBot: canary rollout 25% healthy -> proceeding to 100% in 5m
Sunita (SRE): indicators improving: queued requests down 87%, 504 rate falling toward baseline
Zoe (Incident Lead): good. postmortem owners and action items we need after this stabilizes
Eli (Runtime): action: add a synthetic load test that simulates large-batch fanout with token refresh churn. Owner: Eli. ETA: 2 weeks
Sunita (SRE): action: implement circuit-breaker on auth-proxy backpressure to fail-fast instead of cascading 504s. Owner: Sunita. ETA: 1 week
Mike (Product): action: default batch-size policy change in docs + SDKs to nudge customers away from enormous single batches. Owner: Mike. ETA: 3 days to doc; SDK change 2 weeks
Jess (Support): action: update support playbook with repro steps and quick customer mitigation checklist. Owner: Jess. ETA: 48 hours
Eli (Runtime): action: add better KV-cache telemetry (eviction causes, ttl histogram) and an alert for sustained miss-rate >0.3. Owner: Eli. ETA: 1 week
Zoe (Incident Lead): action: retro + blameless postmortem doc; include timeline, RCA, mitigation timeline, and follow-ups. Owner: Zoe. ETA: 72 hours draft
Sunita (SRE): quick follow-up: push a small hotfix to auth-proxy to tolerate short token service hiccups by queueing refreshes with jitter (non-breaking). Owner: Sunita. ETA: 48 hours
Zoe (Incident Lead): outstanding asks: Eli please paste repro harness and runbook in the postmortem. Jess push comms template to the playbook. Mike coordinate outreach to top impacted accounts.
Eli (Runtime): will add harness to CI as a nightly job and attach to postmortem
Jess (Support): closing update to customers will go out after postmortem draft ready
Zoe (Incident Lead): thanks team — keeping the thread open for timeline and handoff. if anything regresses ping :eyes: and we reopen warroom
Sunita (SRE): final note before we close incident: we should consider autoscaler policy tweak to detect auth-proxy saturation as a signal for routing fallback. Add to backlog.
Zoe (Incident Lead): copied to incident board, moving to postmortem phase. good job everyone :thumbsup:
